title: Advanced Causative Construction With "se laisser"
description: se laisser + infinitive: letting something happen to yourself.

items.translation: to let people push you around / not to resist
items.exampleEn: Don't let them push you around!

items.explain: Depuis sa retraite, il se laisse aller. — Since he retired, he has let himself go.

items.prompt: In French: “to give in to temptation”
items.explain: Je me suis laissé tenter par ce gâteau. — I gave in to that cake.
Il s'est laissé emporter par la colère. — He got carried away by anger.
Nous nous sommes laissé surprendre par la pluie. — We were caught out by the rain.

items.exampleFr: Elle se laisse influencer par ses amis.
items.exampleEn: She lets herself be influenced by her friends.

items.prompt: In French: “to let oneself get discouraged”
items.explain: Ne te laisse pas abattre ! — Don't let it get you down!
En vacances, je me laisse vivre. — On holiday, I take life easy.

items.exampleFr: Il se laisse distraire par son téléphone.
items.exampleEn: He lets his phone distract him.

items.translation: se faire: the subject brings it about; se laisser: the subject passively allows it
items.exampleFr: Il s'est fait convaincre. / Il s'est laissé convaincre.
items.exampleEn: He got himself persuaded. / He let himself be persuaded.

items.prompt: In French (passé composé): “I gave in to temptation.”  (se laisser tenter)
In French: “Don't let it get you down!”  (tu)
In French (passé composé): “She let herself be persuaded.”
